name: iris-1099
description: iris-1099, from inside Claude Code: who needs a 1099 for 2025 or 2026 payments, from your own QuickBooks, Xero or vendor-payments CSV, with the IRS sentence behind each decision, and IRIS Taxpayer Portal CSVs. Open source, local, no account; TINs never leave the machine.

plugins.name: iris-1099
plugins.description: /iris-1099:iris-1099 runs `npx -y --allow-git=root github:agentwares/iris-1099` on a vendor-payments or 1099 report and explains who needs a 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC and why ($600 for 2025 payments, $2,000 for 2026; card and PayPal amounts on the 1099-K; corporations exempt except attorneys and medical), the missing W-9s, and the IRIS CSVs it wrote. Prepared for your review, not tax advice.
